_help: Read by scripts/vehicle_model.gd and blender/make_mobile_cars.py. length: real length in metres. yaw: degrees to turn the model so it lies along Z with its front on the left of tests/view_vehicle.gd's side view. wheels: [front axle z, rear axle z, wheel centre y, tyre radius] in metres as measured in that view. width: tyre width as a fraction of the radius (default 0.75). mass: kg. glass (optional) = window materials that the model paints opaque, with the alpha to draw them at so the people inside show (vehicle_model.gd). cabin (driver seat and steering wheel, car-local metres as returned by vehicle_model.gd build(): +Z forward, +X the driver's/door side, y = 0 where the tyres touch the road): seat = driver's hip point (H-point); wheel_center = steering-wheel rim centre where it is shown; wheel_cut_center = where a right-hand-drive model's wheel is cut from (it is moved to wheel_center); wheel_radius = rim radius to the middle of the grip; wheel_tilt = rim plane angle from vertical in degrees (0 upright, 90 flat; rotation axis = (0, sin, -cos), pointing at the driver); wheel_depth = half thickness of the cut disc (default 0.07); wheel_turn_deg = rim rotation at full steering lock each way; wheel_source = cut (triangles cut from the model) or added (no modelled wheel: a low-poly one is generated); wheel_node = take every triangle of this mesh instead of the disc test; heel (optional) = floor point the driver's heels rest on (default: seat + (0, -0.3, 0.78) for cars, seat + (0, -0.42, 0.52) for vans and buses); passengers (optional, danfos) = passenger hip points, filled 2-4 at random by scripts/vehicle_occupants.gd when the vehicle drives in traffic; passenger_heel_drop (default 0.42) = their floor below the hips. Measured with tests/view_vehicle.gd -- cabin <key>.
